verdict.rationale: Mistral publishes an API reference with documented endpoints, such as List/Retrieve Models, and a quickstart for sending a first API request, so a static reference with example requests exists. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples run in-browser. A community report notes there is no simple sandbox, the OCR endpoint docs lack detail, and a notebook link is inaccessible. The OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable in-docs examples, a publicly accessible OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of a good hands-on reference experience.
